# Plan4 live retention source provenance

This new input is source preparation for the actual live owner. The first checkpoint contains two new static selectors only. No fixture bytes are generated and no completed G5, genesis, runtime-core, allocation, or pure semantic test function is called. Static observations do not construct a directory, writer, file, owner, or runtime. The actual memory adapter and the existing native adapter types are inspected with `size_of` and source accounting functions.

The original G5 static receipts recorded in `input-plan.json` supply only the prior Writer/File/MutableStorageOwner/Plan4Pages/SharedPool/LiveDirectory/Mode sizes. Their evidence remains bound to its original source and ELF. PolicyRef, TargetClass, FlushIo, FlushIoError, and InitClaimRecord sizes without an identified original measurement are reported as baseline/delta UNKNOWN. This is source-value accounting, not a measured stack or runtime-memory bound.

The successor semantic input reuses `../dev3-plan4-empty-retention/vectors/p1-o00/` read-only: exactly 34 files and 550,160 bytes. The original `raw-index.tsv` SHA, every file length/SHA, and the total are checked before using the literals. Actual reserve and INIT run before the N=0 lifecycle; no preexisting Status owner is fabricated. Recovered epochs, verified base handoff, and fresh-process recovery remain unconnected work and cannot receive a current live PASS.

The new harness requires exact source/ELF/input identity environment values and prints one context plus BEGIN/PASS or FAIL for each selected ID. Unknown IDs, duplicate IDs, overlapping explicit include/exclude, and empty selections fail before the body. The caller runner must bind loaded source and immutable input hashes and refuse replay of completed IDs. Case markers are not evidence until an approved execution produces immutable receipts.

The successor has 32 mandatory IDs: two already observed static IDs and 30 new memory IDs in six exact selectors. The static bodies are unchanged and must not be repeated merely because the new children are linked. Additional S5 consists of 32 unique inputs in three ignored selectors: 12 short reads, eight prefix corruptions, and 12 successful partial writes. The total inventory is 64 IDs in 11 selectors; current source preparation does not claim S5 execution or whole G6 acceptance.

`plan4_retention_literal_tests.rs` independently places all reserve/cancel/INIT fields into zero-filled byte arrays and computes SHA-256 seals. Its provenance is the preserved `scripts/dev3_status_init_literals.py` field recipe, whose SHA is pinned in the input. The old script is neither imported nor executed. The adaptation fixes the selected page to plan4 page 9 and derives its expected allocator entry from the independent P00 image. Work IDs 1/2, births 1/3, generation 2/3, native indices, token kind, profile digest, resource rows, physical/group headers, cell patches, page afterimages, and complete frame SHA are explicit literals. No product encoder, decoder, materializer, descriptor builder, or transition supplies expected bytes.

L01 compares the two new population frames followed by the five existing N=0 frames in the actual WAL: lengths 21,200 + 38,000 + 19,672 + 56,712 + 3,040 + 56,712 + 55,112 = 250,448 bytes after the 4,096-byte epoch header. L02 independently compares two reserve/cancel pairs with preserved then advanced generations. The other cases use actual setup to reach their own new boundary; calling setup is not credited as a repeated acceptance of lower or completed test functions.

F01 pauses after the actual Root capture at L3, then pauses a genuine Begin at the original durability boundary after L4 staging. It requires disk EOF to remain at L3 while RAM reports complete L4, and requires the captured L3 flush to succeed and retain the dirty L4/recLSN3 obligation. F03 holds a real content read lock in a bounded thread, observes retired-but-not-finalized state, then proves continuation adds no physical I/O. F06 mutates the fixed WAL prefix at the third read of offset zero (header, first hash, final hash), after replay, and requires rejection before any home/DWB writes. All fault/hook occurrence keys and expected causes are listed per ID in the input. PrefixError in the actual write adapter writes 8,192 bytes before returning an error; PrefixEof reads 17 bytes and then returns zero.

Error-preservation snapshots compare every RawSnapshot field, including published registration, and the original slot request/generation plus full page bytes. Mutex-held observations are copied out before assertions, preventing a failed oracle from poisoning the adapter during owner cleanup. New cases clear trace first and then take their effect baseline; fresh setup mutations are not compared with a cleared trace.

The semantic export must start from immutable `live-tests-r2/source`, then overlay these new test children, the child module declaration, and this input/provenance. Later recovery/prefix product changes in the working tree are excluded. Original static failures and successor source-specific static PASS receipts are retained separately. The historical static-only JSON is preserved under the path recorded by `previous_input` before this metadata successor. The 64 MiB host-backing value is a conservative test-fixture proposal, separate from the accepted product 64 KiB source census; it is not a measured process-memory or stack claim. All execution and aggregate budgets require the root's frozen input gate.

The r1 source adds direct live control-row checks after every lifecycle step: Aging Start/Begin/unchanged-on-Rollback/Abort/Finish all match their independent descriptors; the actual stable ATT slot matches Tx Begin and Rollback descriptors. Successful AbortEnd clears its ATT row before returning. The test therefore checks that cleared bank and separately compares the actual staged operation frame's sender-after bytes `[416,1952)` with `tx-abort.descriptor`, rather than inventing a retained terminal ATT row. The original r0 three child sources, input, and provenance are preserved unchanged in `artifacts/dev3/plan4-g6-recovery-20261024/fresh30-source-r0/`; no raw bytes, case IDs, product/static bodies, or execution results changed.
